hypothesis: A single training-fitted linear map of bank-centered student terminal responses can generalize to unseen PushT episodes and improve teacher-objective elite selection.

fit.rows: Reuse exactly the 512 temporal-balanced Phase2 training contexts and their cached 64-candidate teacher targets from the previous frozen balanced-row file.
fit.bank_centering: Center student and teacher terminal latents separately across 64 candidates within each context.
fit.weight: Each context contributes its response squared error divided by max(teacher bank-centered terminal latent MSE, 1e-6).
fit.matrix: One shared 192x192 ridge map W: solve (G+lambda I)W=H+lambda I, where G=mean_context X^T X/(64*teacher_energy), H=mean_context X^T Y/(64*teacher_energy).
fit.scalar_control: The same weighted ridge objective restricted to W=alpha I; alpha=(trace(H)+lambda*192)/(trace(G)+lambda*192).
fit.inference: For a candidate bank, replace only terminal zS_i by mean(zS)+[zS_i-mean(zS)]W. Earlier four horizons and the bank mean stay unchanged. No teacher computation or target is used at inference.
fit.checkpoint_selection: Fixed prior terminal_response step_3000 checkpoint; no retraining or checkpoint search.

evaluation.selection_rule: Reproduce the prior validated shuffle and its first eight selected IDs; from the same valid[600:] order exclude all prior train/heldout/manifest IDs and the prior eight fresh IDs, then take the first eight remaining. Persist identities before opening any new evaluation rows.
evaluation.paired_unit: Episode; first subtract within each identical bank, take the median over six banks per episode, then the median over eight episodes.
evaluation.primary_comparison: linear minus identity; scalar is a diagnostic control, not a fallback selected from evaluation data.
evaluation.latency: Cached H=1 latent plus five-step student rollout and bank adapter on 300 candidates; 3 warmups and 10 timed repetitions, compared with the official predictor on the same bank.

gates.overall: Predictor-level GO requires all relative, absolute, and stratum conditions. Even GO would not establish CEM or closed-loop viability.

anti_leakage.preprocessing_isolation: Episode/task-level only; the official dataset-wide scaler may have read columns from held-out episodes.

execution.allocation: One guarded PBS GPU compute-node job for cached-row inference, ridge fit, and new-episode evaluation.
execution.login_node: Connection, small control uploads, qsub, qstat, and small result fetch only.
